gloss: permanent residency; right of permanent residence

definitions.gloss: permanent residency; right of permanent residence
definitions.explanation: The legal right to reside permanently in a country. In Japan, this refers to a specific visa status that allows foreign nationals to live and work in Japan indefinitely.

examples.japanese: {永住権|えいじゅうけん}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
{永住権|えいじゅうけん}の{申請|しんせい}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Applying for permanent residency takes time.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}で{十|じゅう}{年|ねん}{以上|いじょう}{暮|く}らして、やっと{永住権|えいじゅうけん}が{認|みと}められた。
examples.english: After living in Japan for over ten years, I was finally granted permanent residency.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal legal term commonly encountered in immigration contexts. Relevant for foreign nationals living in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}を{取得|しゅとく}する (to obtain permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}を{申請|しんせい}する (to apply for permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}が{認|みと}められる (to be granted permanent residency)
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}{保持者|ほじしゃ} (permanent resident)

RELATED:
- {在留資格|ざいりゅうしかく} (residence status)
- {帰化|きか} (naturalization — becoming a citizen, distinct from permanent residency)
